proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {i, j, k} := by decide +revert
  have hH : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.circumcenter = (t.points i -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    rw [t.orthocenter_vsub_circumcenter_eq_sum_vsub, hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton, add_assoc]
  have hj' : ‖t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter‖ = t.circumradius := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius j
  have hk' : ‖t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter‖ = t.circumradius := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius k
  have e1 : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.points i = (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right t.orthocenter (t.points i) t.circumcenter, hH]; abel
  rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V t.orthocenter, e1, dist_eq_norm_vsub V (t.points j) (t.points k),
    ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right (t.points j) (t.points k) t.circumcenter, norm_add_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, hj', hk']
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist (t.points i) t.orthocenter ^ 2 + dist (t.points j) (t.points k) ^ 2 = 4 * t.circumradius ^ 2
